Name: Jeelh's Obelisk Statues
Author: Jeelh
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/FGalk28.png[/img]

This mod replaces the games Obelisks with statues representing each area.

Cat for the Desert, Rabbit for the Farm, Racoon for the Mountains, Bird for Ginger Island,
and lastly the Penguin? Owl? for the Beach. Really I'm not sure what animal it is.

Anyway, they match the totems in each area so it's easy to tell which is which.

There are two variants which change the colour of the base of the statue.


You [b]don't[/b] need this if you're already using 'Jeelh's Buildings' as they are also part of that mod!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/KCilBwk.png[/img]

[b]3[/b]. Download the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]
[b]4[/b]. Download Jeelh's Greenhouse
[b]5[/b]. Extract into your \Stardew Valley\Mods\ folder
